name: Bullseye
text: bullseye ld-001 bullseye 3-7 yd (pistol) print at 100% on us letter; keep corners flat. phone 1-3 yd away, all 4 corner markers in view. wait for the blue outline, then say "start" or tap start. aim small: center ring is 5 pts.

name: Qualification Silhouette
text: silhouette ld-002 qualification silhouette 3-7 yd (scaled ~1/3) center mass: x/10 ring 10, 9 ring 9, 8 ring 8. head box 10; rest of head and body 5. outside the silhouette: miss. x (center oval) scores 10; count xs for tiebreaks.

name: 5-Dot Sequence
text: five-dot ld-003 5-dot sequence 3-5 yd shoot dots 1 to 5 in order. out-of-order or missed dot = 0 pts. each correct dot = 5 pts. build speed only once all 5 are clean.

name: Shotgun Clays
text: clays ld-004 shotgun clays 3-5 yd (shotgun cartridge) shotgun mode: clay zones grow by the 0.55in spread. dashed ring = pattern edge: 2 pts (fixed size). black dome 5 pts (aim here: lasers read reliably on black). orange clay (incl. spread) 3 pts. mount, swing, shoot each clay once.

name: Hostage
text: hostage ld-005 hostage 3-5 yd hatched figure = hostage: -10 per hit. hostage overlaps the threat: overlap hits count as hostage. head a box and left body are clean shots.

name: Crowd Hunt (Letter)
text: crowd ld-301 crowd hunt (letter) 3-5 yd hear/read the bolo; find one person; 2 to chest. wrong person +5 s. faded = bystander +10 s. l1: 1 trait. l2: 2. l3: 3 or relative spot. mic on for spoken calls. say "start" or tap.

name: Crowd Hunt (Tabloid)
text: crowd-tabloid ld-302 crowd hunt (tabloid) 3-5 yd hear/read the bolo; find one person; 2 to chest. wrong person +5 s. faded = bystander +10 s. l1: 1 trait. l2: 2. l3: 3 or relative spot. print tabloid 11x17 at 100%. say "start" or tap.

name: Carnival Shoot
text: carnival ld-401 carnival shoot 3-5 yd free fire: pig 3, duck 2, bullseye 5/3/1. pigs p1-3 left to right; bullseyes b1-b5 top row first. ducks d1-d4 on the rail, d5-d7 on posts. called mode: "duck 3", "all pigs"... wrong item -2. mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Sink-the-Ship (8x8)
text: battle ld-402 sink-the-ship (8x8) 3-7 yd the app hides a random fleet (5 ships, 17 cells). shoot a cell: it says hit, miss or "you sunk my cruiser". score = shots to sink the whole fleet (lower is better). timed mode: same game against a 3 min clock.

name: Card Shoot
text: cards ld-403 card shoot 3-5 yd 4-colour deck: spades black, hearts plum, diamonds blue, clubs green. poker: shoot 5 cards, the app scores your best hand. call-out: the app calls "queen of hearts", "any club"... wrong card -2.

name: Card Shoot (Tabloid)
text: cards-tabloid ld-404 card shoot (tabloid) 3-5 yd 4-colour deck: spades black, hearts plum, diamonds blue, clubs green. poker: shoot 5 cards, the app scores your best hand. call-out: the app calls "queen of hearts", "any club"... wrong card -2.

name: Maritime Interdiction
text: maritime ld-501 maritime interdiction 5-10 yd engines = -0 (disabling fire), hull = -1. all civilian craft (fishing, sail, yacht, jet ski, ferry, kayaks, sport boat) are no-shoot: -20. decision mode: only fast boats with bales/drums are smugglers. mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Maritime Interdiction (Tabloid)
text: maritime-tabloid ld-502 maritime interdiction (tabloid) 5-10 yd engines = -0 (disabling fire), hull = -1. all civilian craft (fishing, sail, yacht, jet ski, ferry, kayaks, sport boat) are no-shoot: -20. decision mode: only fast boats with bales/drums are smugglers. mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Counter-Terror
text: ct ld-503 counter-terror 5-7 yd head -0, body -1. militants are told apart by kit only. civilians are no-shoot: -20. vest wearer: head shot only. any body hit = vest strike (+5 s, -5). mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Counter-Terror (Tabloid)
text: ct-tabloid ld-504 counter-terror (tabloid) 5-7 yd head -0, body -1. militants are told apart by kit only. civilians are no-shoot: -20. vest wearer: head shot only. any body hit = vest strike (+5 s, -5). mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Friend or Foe
text: fof ld-505 friend or foe 5-10 yd same camo on both sides: read the tape bands (yellow, blue, white). each round the app names the friendly side and the tape to engage. hitting a friendly = fratricide -25. head -0, body -1. sandbags / trench are hard cover (no score). mic on, say "start".

name: Friend or Foe (Tabloid)
text: fof-tabloid ld-506 friend or foe (tabloid) 5-10 yd same camo on both sides: read the tape bands (yellow, blue, white). each round the app names the friendly side and the tape to engage. hitting a friendly = fratricide -25. head -0, body -1. sandbags / trench are hard cover (no score). mic on, say "start".

name: Ankle Draw: Store
text: ankle ld-601 ankle draw: store 3 yd, shooter kneeling (aim slightly upward) voice start only: say "start". gun in an ankle holster. start standing, seated or walking (the drill says which); on the beep drop to a kneel behind the counter / rack / car door. threats show above cover: hits on cover do not count. head -0/-1, chest -0/-1. faded people on the mezzanine = bystander +10 s (a high miss lands on them). score shown at the end.

name: Ankle Draw: Store (Tabloid)
text: ankle-tabloid ld-602 ankle draw: store (tabloid) 3 yd, shooter kneeling (aim slightly upward) voice start only: say "start". gun in an ankle holster. start standing, seated or walking (the drill says which); on the beep drop to a kneel behind the counter / rack / car door. threats show above cover: hits on cover do not count. head -0/-1, chest -0/-1. faded people on the mezzanine = bystander +10 s (a high miss lands on them). score shown at the end.

name: IDPA-style Threat
text: idpa-threat ld-101 idpa-style threat 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per pd). head: -0 circle, rest of head box -1. miss = 5 pd. classic kraft-style threat, own artwork.

name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Left
text: idpa-hc-left ld-102 idpa-style hard cover: left 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) black = hard cover: hits there do not count. only the right half of the threat is exposed. scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per pd). hit only in hard cover = miss (5 pd).

name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Lower
text: idpa-hc-lower ld-103 idpa-style hard cover: lower 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) lower body is behind hard cover (black). upper -0 arc and head are exposed. scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per pd). hit only in hard cover = miss (5 pd).

name: IDPA-style Hard Cover: Diagonal
text: idpa-hc-diagonal ld-104 idpa-style hard cover: diagonal 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) diagonal hard cover over the right side. precision on the exposed -0 edge. scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per pd). hit only in hard cover = miss (5 pd).

name: IDPA-style Non-Threat (open hands)
text: idpa-nonthreat ld-105 idpa-style non-threat (open hands) 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) open hands = non-threat. do not shoot. any hit anywhere on it = +5 s (hnt). use as a no-shoot / shoot-through drill. pair with ld-106 for threat + non-threat.

name: IDPA-style Practice (dark -0)
text: idpa-practice ld-106 idpa-style practice (dark -0) 3 yd = ~13.5 yd sim (1/4.5 scale) white practice face on black backing. -0 circles are dark blue, not red: a red zone would mask the red laser dot. scored as points down: -0 / -1 / -3 (+1 s per pd).

name: IDPA-style Threat + Non-Threat
text: idpa-nt-pair ld-107 idpa-style threat + non-threat 3 yd = ~15 yd sim (1/5 scale) left = non-threat (hands): +5 s per hit. right = threat: score -0/-1/-3. miss on the threat = 5 pd. 1/5 scale: 3 yd = ~15 yd sim.

name: IDPA-style Multiple Threats
text: idpa-multi ld-108 idpa-style multiple threats 3 yd = ~27 yd sim (1/9 scale) engage t1, t2, t3 left to right, 2 each. out-of-order engagement = pe (+3 s). each pd = +1 s. miss = 5 pd. 1/9 scale: 3 yd = ~27 yd sim.

name: IDPA-style All Variations
text: idpa-all-tabloid ld-110 idpa-style all variations 3 yd = ~27 yd sim (1/9 scale) drill calls targets in random order (spoken + on screen). mozambique (t5): 2 body, then 1 head, in order. t6 and the front figure on t8 are non-threats: +5 s/hit. black = hard cover: hits there do not count. out of order / wrong mozambique part = pe +3 s.

name: IDPA-style All Variations
text: idpa-all-letter ld-111 idpa-style all variations 3 yd = ~42 yd sim (1/14 scale) drill calls targets in random order (spoken + on screen). mozambique (t5): 2 body, then 1 head, in order. t6 and the front figure on t8 are non-threats: +5 s/hit. black = hard cover: hits there do not count. out of order / wrong mozambique part = pe +3 s.

name: Die Hard: Hans (HK P7)
text: dh-hans ld-201 die hard: hans (hk p7) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) nakatomi 30th floor: the leader draws his p7. mozambique: 2 to the chest -0, then 1 to the head -0. outlines are faint on purpose: read the anatomy. say "start" or tap; gun holstered until the beep.

name: Die Hard: Karl (MP5A3, stairwell)
text: dh-karl ld-202 die hard: karl (mp5a3, stairwell) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) stairwell: karl comes up the stairs, lower body behind the rail. 2 to the exposed chest/head. concrete rail = hard cover. faint outlines = scoring zones on real anatomy. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Tony (MP5A3, cabinet)
text: dh-tony ld-203 die hard: tony (mp5a3, cabinet) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) 31st floor: tony behind a file cabinet. 2 to the exposed chest -0. cabinet = hard cover. faint outlines = scoring zones. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Franco (AUG, desk)
text: dh-franco ld-204 die hard: franco (aug, desk) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) lobby: franco behind the reception desk. 2 to exposed chest/head. desk = hard cover. faint outlines = scoring zones. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Heinrich (AUG, pillar)
text: dh-heinrich ld-205 die hard: heinrich (aug, pillar) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) vault floor: heinrich half behind a pillar. 2 to the exposed chest -0. marble pillar = hard cover. faint outlines = scoring zones. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Eddie (fake guard)
text: dh-eddie ld-206 die hard: eddie (fake guard) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) lobby guard desk: is the "guard" armed and hostile? gun = 2 to the chest. hands up = say "drop it!" in 3 s. hit on a compliant call = +5 s. mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Theo (vault tech)
text: dh-theo ld-207 die hard: theo (vault tech) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) vault: the tech has his hands up... for now. hands up = say "show me your hands!" in 3 s, do not shoot. gun = 2 to the chest. mic on. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Uli (AUG, lobby)
text: dh-uli ld-212 die hard: uli (aug, lobby) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) lobby: the quiet one with the aug. 2 to the chest -0 (vest: aim center). faint outlines = scoring zones. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Sgt. Powell (FRIENDLY)
text: dh-powell ld-213 die hard: sgt. powell (friendly) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) lapd sergeant arrives: friendly, do not shoot. hold fire 4 s, say "police! friendly!" any hit = friendly fire +10 s and fail. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: "Bill Clay" impostor
text: dh-billclay ld-208 die hard: "bill clay" impostor 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) roof stairs: a "hostage" with an accent. wait for the call. hands up = verbal "get down!" within 3 s. gun = 2 chest + 1 head. hit on a compliant call = +5 s. mic on.

name: Die Hard: Roof Finale
text: dh-finale ld-209 die hard: roof finale 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) roof finale: hans shields behind holly; eddie (mp5a3 at low ready) covers him. exactly 2: hans exposed side-chest -0, then eddie head -0. holly = hostage: any hit = +5 s and fail. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Christmas Party
text: dh-party ld-210 die hard: christmas party 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) 30th floor party: a guest stands beside tony. find the gun: 2 to the armed man only. unarmed guest = +5 s. faint outlines = scoring zones. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Lobby (Powell arrives)
text: dh-lobby ld-214 die hard: lobby (powell arrives) 3 yd = ~30 yd sim (figure ~1/10 scale) lobby: sgt. powell walks in as uli opens up. 2 to uli only. powell = friendly. hit on powell = +10 s and fail. say "start" or tap.

name: Die Hard: Nakatomi Plaza line-up
text: dh-nakatomi ld-211 die hard: nakatomi plaza line-up 3 yd = ~32 yd sim (1/11 scale) seven crew t1-t7 + sgt. powell (friendly, +10 s). overlaps: the front person takes the hit. calls: 2 chest; "head" = 1 head. hands up = verbal. mic on. print tabloid 11x17 at 100%.
